recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if a future final work-group decision such as FHIR-38064 replaces the current UCUM-to-calendar-unit guidance or defines a separate calendar-unit code system for core FHIR use.
issue_request: FHIR-24858 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking the FHIRPath appendix to warn implementers that UCUM fixed-duration units such as `a` and `mo` differ from calendar year/month semantics when FHIR UCUM Quantities are converted to FHIRPath System.Quantity.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 9c94e6c4fa0df8b08d19d5d9519a2c4e416c3715 on 2022-08-29, which added a dragons block to source/fhirpath.html explaining the UCUM-to-calendar-duration mapping and the 365.25-day/30-day distinction for `a` and `mo`.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-03-23 confirm the decision to add the dragon warning and note possible future separate-code-system work. A later Zulip thread raised concerns about UCUM calendar-unit guidance and led to FHIR-38064, but that issue remains Triaged/Unresolved and is not a final replacement decision. The related Timing guidance issue FHIR-24857 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhirpath.html is included in the build through publish.ini and its Use of FHIR Quantity section already maps time-valued UCUM units to FHIRPath calendar duration units and warns about the differing UCUM definitions for `a` and `mo`.
